placement.guard_ring_and_well_separation: pending native device and isolation review

TOP_added_fixed_capacitance_F.authoritative_metric: CDAC gain error from standalone fixture weights of the extracted view with its planned fill <= 4.7% (specs/arch.json error_budget.gain_error_allocation)
TOP_added_fixed_capacitance_F.basis: Screening proxy per side: GE ~= Cp/C_eff with C_eff ~= 1.22 pF (1.025 pF units plus extracted TOP-bottom coupling), so 4.7% ~= 57 fF of TOP capacitance to 0, VSS, VDD and fixed references. Prefill paired CDAC measures 38.5 fF, leaving about 19 fF for its planned fill. Top-level TOP wiring and comparator/sampler layout share 0.8% (~10 fF) separately.

TOP_differential_capacitance_imbalance_F.basis: Side gain mismatch <= ~0.1% of C_eff; it converts common-mode reference steps into differential error. Prefill paired CDAC measures 0.17 fF.

CDAC_systematic_linearity_LSB.basis: |DNL| and endpoint |INL| from gain-normalized extracted bit weights (specs/arch.json error_budget.layout_systematic_linearity_lsb); prefill paired CDAC 0.33/0.29, original layout 0.15/0.10

measured.method: standalone transient cdac-stacked-mx-20261118 of the merged extraction; the charge model gives the same values

comparator_input_route_capacitance_F.scope: Added fixed capacitance per TOP net from top-level TOP wiring to the comparator and the Bootstrap output, including device-side layout
comparator_input_route_capacitance_F.basis: 0.8% of C_eff (specs/arch.json gain_error_allocation.top_level_top_wiring_and_device_layout); C_eff = 52.11 fF fixed TOPP load / 4.231% TT gain error of se-xref-peripheral-dense = 1.232 pF, so 9.85 fF. 9.8 fF per side kept every code on its gain-corrected target in the SS-cold and FF-hot route checks.
comparator_input_route_capacitance_F.sampler_route_basis: SS-cold acquisition residual rose from 0.052 LSB (ideal wiring) to 0.093 LSB with 412 ohm and to 0.148 LSB with 825 ohm between the Bootstrap output and TOP; 825 ohm uses 0.096 of the 0.10 LSB reserved for top-level parasitics

reference_gate_route_delay_s.scope: One-way top-level CODE0-7/PRESET route from the SAR macro pins to the XREF pins, 50% to 50%, receiver load included
reference_gate_route_delay_s.basis: FF hot (CBEST_T) is the binding corner: the worst decision error rises about 0.5 mLSB per ps of CODE-bus delay (RC check sar8-allxr-ffh-verify-a at 51 ps measured; ideal-delay diagnostic at 130 ps). At 100 ps the prediction is 0.213 LSB against nominal rails (routed limit 0.25) and 0.153 LSB with the 0.061 LSB static leakage offset removed. SS cold and TT are not limited by this route.
reference_gate_route_delay_s.pre_layout_model_loads: Derived with the not-drawn model loads CL_COMP_P, CL_COMP_N and CL_CMP_CLK (about 10 fF each) in place. Lighter routed wiring speeds the comparator, which can shorten the FF-hot time from a plate update to the next decision; Stage 6 rechecks this budget with the extracted wiring.

measured_internal.event: Worst command-to-50% crossing across selected physical gate contacts, both directions with all bits switching

sar_handshake_route_delay_s.status: adopted 2026-11-22 from Stage 2 (issue #12), with the load limit and without comparator output buffers
sar_handshake_route_delay_s.scope: One-way top-level CMP_CLK route (SAR to comparator) and COMP_P/COMP_N routes (comparator to SAR), 50% to 50%
sar_handshake_route_delay_s.basis: The binding quantity is load, not delay: COMP_P/COMP_N are the StrongARM latch nodes (no output buffer), so route capacitance slows regeneration, most at small inputs. SS cold: 7.77 ns read margin with ideal wiring; 4.16 ns with the planned floorplan lengths at 0.2 fF/um and 20 ohm/um (sar8-allxr-ssc-verify-s1, 11.4 fF per comparator output, 19.7 ps measured one-way); 0.66 ns at twice those lengths. The cost is linear in load, about 3.6 ns per planned length, so the routed 1 ns floor is reached near 1.9x. The limits are the verified 1x point.
sar_handshake_route_delay_s.pre_layout_model_loads: Every Stage 2 run, the route checks included, kept the not-drawn model loads CL_COMP_P, CL_COMP_N and CL_CMP_CLK (about 10 fF each, Layout/specs/interfaces.json not_drawn_instances). The 7.77 ns ideal-wiring control therefore already carried about 10 fF on each comparator output and on CMP_CLK, and the route checks added their route load on top: about 21 fF per output at 1x and 33 fF at 2x. Top-level LVS and extraction omit the model loads and the routed wiring replaces them, so load_limit_F leaves about 10 fF of headroom against the verified 1x point.

reference_charge_per_conversion_C.scope: Die-side charge drawn from VREFP, and returned through VREFN, in any one 100 ns frame; every Stage 6 corner and frame
reference_charge_per_conversion_C.basis: Calibrated charge model maximum 2.85 pC (code 127, full reversal plus PRESET) times the 1.3 FF 0.99 V and top-level extraction allowance. The model is the ideal CDAC charge plus 2.13 fC per toggled unit, fitted to the measured TT frames (2.80/1.43/1.25 pC). Mean over codes 2.05 pC, so the off-chip reference supplies about 21 uA at 10 MS/s, at most 37 uA.

measured.evidence: stage1-rail-charge-adc-post-b (analysis of se-xref-adc-post-b, TT 0.9 V 27 C, coupled XREF/CDAC extraction, 50 ohm / 4 pF fixture)
measured.vrefn_return_match: within 0.1% of VREFP in every frame

reference_event_charge_C.scope: Largest die-side VREFP (and VREFN) charge within any 1 ns window
reference_event_charge_C.basis: Calibrated model maximum 1.46 pC (PRESET after a full reversal) times 1.3. The on-chip reference series resistor and decoupling are sized for this event.

reference_pin_peak_current_A.scope: Peak current of each reference rail, summed over its two bond pins, with the Stage 6 system model
reference_pin_peak_current_A.basis: Budgeted network model on the 9 x 9 ring 3.25 mA nominal and 4.33 mA worst over the tolerance box, with the sharper 0.5 ns charge pulse that over-predicts the measured fixture peak (3.33 model vs 2.60 mA measured); limit = 1.2 x box worst. A higher value means the on-chip damping or decoupling differs from the budgeted network.

reference_span_droop_V.scope: Peak drop of VREFP-VREFN at the CDAC reference trunk, after the on-chip series resistors
reference_span_droop_V.basis: Qualified envelope: the coupled XREF/CDAC passed every TT decision of se-xref-adc-post-b with up to 259.8 mV measured span droop. Budgeted network model on the 9 x 9 ring 113 mV nominal, 148 mV worst over the tolerance box.

reference_decision_error_LSB.scope: Reference-induced plate error at each comparator edge: the signed TOP error against nominal rails minus the same error against the instantaneous CDAC-trunk rails
reference_decision_error_LSB.basis: Share of the 0.10 LSB top-level reserve between the Stage 2 (0.15 LSB) and Stage 6 (0.25 LSB) plate-settling criteria in chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#12. The plate-settling limit stays authoritative. Budgeted network (15 ohm, 8 pF, double reference bonds, 1.0 pF of pads, and the 9 x 9 ring's pad-to-core routes: 0.85 ohm, 0.17 nH and 0.27 pF per rail): 0.030/0.012/0.004 LSB at FF cold/TT/SS cold. Over the tolerance box (series R x0.8-1.2, decoupling x0.75-1.25, 0.5-1.5 nH per rail, route 0.14-1.2 ohm from M9 at -40 C to M8 at 125 C rcworst) the worst is 0.043/0.020/0.004 LSB. The 7 x 7 ring's 0-2 ohm bracket gave 0.048 LSB; coupling from the shared TACVDD/TACVSS bus through the reference pads adds at most 0.0002 LSB; the single-bond alternative (20 ohm, 6 pF, 1-3 nH) reached 0.105 LSB at FF cold.

supply_charge_per_conversion_C.scope: Charge drawn from VDD by the whole ADC core in any one 100 ns frame; every Stage 6 corner and frame
supply_charge_per_conversion_C.basis: Measured TT maximum 5.26 pC times 1.3. Average about 53 uA (48 uW) at TT, so VDD plus reference power stays far below the 1 mW target.

supply_event_charge_C.scope: Largest VDD charge of the whole core within any 1 ns window
supply_event_charge_C.basis: Measured TT 0.81 pC (XREF PRESET of 255 units plus SAR DONE) times 1.3. The branch decoupling below is sized from this event and its split.

supply_pin_peak_current_A.scope: Sum of the VDD package-pin peak currents
supply_pin_peak_current_A.basis: Measured 3.70 mA at an ideal source (TT) times 1.48, the FF-cold/TT supply-peak ratio of the eight-bit XREF transition (Layout/results/reference_driver.json). The branch models give 1.75/1.52/1.75 mA.

supply_droop_V.scope: Peak drop of VDD-VSS below the source value at the supply pins of each block (XREF, SAR, comparator, Bootstrap)
supply_droop_V.basis: 5% of 0.9 V, which keeps SS 0.81 V above 0.765 V. In-core comparator strap bounce of 5-7 mV changed no decision or delay. The timing-margin and settling criteria stay authoritative. Budgeted branch decoupling model, ADC core alone: 24-40 mV. On the 9 x 9 ring with its planned pad bulk (114-132 pF per branch) at the 6 ohm maximum feed: 14-20 mV per branch, and 14-20 mV with the shared TACVDD/TACVSS bus and every branch firing together; cross-branch coupling through the bus at most 2.9 mV.

stage6_supply_model.status: Chosen 2026-11-21 for the Stage 6 top-level checks; replaces the 50 ohm / 4 pF reference fixture there. Block and Stage 2 tests keep the fixture.

supply_source.basis: Same board model as the references, at the corner VDD

pins.supply_branches: One AVDD/AVSS pad pair per branch (analog, reference pair XREF/CDAC, SAR). On the 9 x 9 ring (chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#23) every AVDD/AVSS pad is PVDD3AC/PVSS3AC, so all of them also share the TACVDD/TACVSS bus; the in-core branch meshes stay separate.

shared_bus.basis: Narrowest TACVDD/TACVSS strips of PVDD3AC_V_G, PVSS3AC_V_G and PFILLER20A_G in the 9-metal tphn28hpcpgv18 LEF, at 0.428 ohm/sq per layer (PDK tech LEF); coplanar strips 2.2 um apart for the inductance

reference_rail.arrangement: Two bonds per rail on adjacent pads in the order VREFP, VREFN, VREFP, VREFN; mutual inductance not credited. Both pads load the rail, 2 x 0.5 pF.

pad_to_core_route.basis: The two routes of one rail in parallel, ahead of the on-chip resistor, on the 9 x 9 ring (chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#23): VREFP 297.9/317.9 um and VREFN 263.9/371.9 um, about 38.5 squares at 4 um. M8 0.022 ohm/sq at 25 C (PDK tech LEF) gives 0.85 ohm; the range runs from M9 at -40 C (0.0035 ohm/sq) to M8 at 125 C with rcworst_T thickness (0.031 ohm/sq). F is M8 area and edge capacitance to substrate; H scales the earlier 0.1 nH assumption with length (a coplanar-strip estimate of the interleaved bundle gives about a third of it).

package_per_pin.decided: 2026-11-21: double reference bonds accepted; 2026-11-22: 9 x 9 ring with shared TACVDD/TACVSS bus (chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#23)

drawn.decided: 2026-11-22, Stage 4b (chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#30); the values above stay the Stage 1 budget design point
drawn.series_basis: Boundary pin to the pair's rail end, 17.21 ohm on VREFP and on VREFN: pad-side routing 1.42 ohm, RREF 12.02 ohm (PDK rupolym model, TT 25 C), trunk-side routing 3.76/3.77 ohm (flat xRC, typical). Inside 15 ohm +-20 %.

rref.rows: two R90 rows of 26 per rail

drawn.span_decoupling_basis: 164 nmoscap (wr 2.5 um, lr 0.8 um), 328 um2 of gate at 19 fF/um2 (+0.9 V, TT). The reference regions hold at most about 6.3 pF. Inside 8 pF +-25 %.
drawn.rail_budget_check: Tolerance box around the drawn values (series x0.8-1.2, decoupling x0.75-1.25, 0.5-1.5 nH per rail, the 9 x 9 route range): decision error 0.035 / 0.017 / 0.004 LSB at FF cold / TT / SS cold, span droop 177 mV, pin peak 4.64 mA per rail, inside the limits below.

on_chip_reference.topology: On each rail both pads join ahead of the series resistor; the resistor feeds the CDAC reference trunk, and the decoupling sits between the two trunks. No capacitor from VREFN to VSS: at 0 V an NMOS gate on VREFN does not invert.

netlist.status: Interface for the Stage 6 top and the LVS source. The LVS source and the extracted netlist use the drawn devices (drawn); a pre-layout Stage 6 netlist uses ideal elements at the drawn values.
netlist.wrapper: A core wrapper subcircuit holds the reference network and instantiates the unchanged sar_adc8_join_r4 with its VREFP/VREFN ports on the trunk nets, so Stage 2 keeps testing that cell with its fixture.

nets.VREFP: Wrapper port; both VREFP pads join here, ahead of RREFP
nets.VREFN: Wrapper port; both VREFN pads join here, ahead of RREFN
nets.VREFP_TRUNK: RREFP output, the VREFP port of sar_adc8_join_r4
nets.VREFN_TRUNK: RREFN output, the VREFN port of sar_adc8_join_r4

devices.RREFP: VREFP to VREFP_TRUNK, rupolym 0.5 x 0.5 um x 52 in parallel (12.0 ohm); 17.2 ohm pin to rail end with the routing
devices.RREFN: VREFN to VREFN_TRUNK, rupolym 0.5 x 0.5 um x 52 in parallel (12.0 ohm); 17.2 ohm pin to rail end with the routing
devices.CREF: VREFP_TRUNK to VREFN_TRUNK, 164 nmoscap wr 2.5 / lr 0.8 um (6.23 pF), PLUS on VREFP_TRUNK

pad_bulk_decoupling.status: Recommended for the IO ring; the ADC core meets the budget without it.
pad_bulk_decoupling.feed_definition: Loop resistance, VDD path plus VSS path, from the pad bulk to the block decoupling: the ring feed from the bulk to the ADC boundary pins plus the in-core strap

ring_feed_at_10um_M8_ohm.min_width_um: M8 at 125 C rcworst: 4.8 um keeps the pair's pad-to-pin path under 6 ohm; 6.3 um keeps the SAR's bulk-to-pin feed under 1 ohm (1.2 um with M8 and M9 stacked)
ring_feed_at_10um_M8_ohm.in_core_strap: The remaining 5.4-6.0 ohm belongs to the in-core strap. On M2-M7 (0.54 ohm/sq at 125 C rcworst) 2.7 ohm per rail is about five squares, so the in-core feeds stay on M8/M9 down to via stacks at each decap region.

pad_bulk_decoupling.shared_bus_check: With the shared TACVDD/TACVSS bus and every branch firing on the same FF-cold updates, droop at the 6 ohm feed is 17.8 (analog), 19.5 (pair) and 13.9 mV (SAR), within 1.3 mV of the per-branch model. Cross-branch coupling through the bus is at most 2.9 mV peak and 0.46 mV at the comparator edges; through the reference pads' capacitance it adds 0.0002 LSB to the reference decision error.
pad_bulk_decoupling.reference: None: bulk ahead of the reference series resistors raises the decision error (0.15-0.96 LSB for 30-335 pF with single bonds).

on_chip_supply_decoupling_F.feed_definition: feed_ohm is the loop resistance from the boundary pins to the block decoupling with no pad bulk; with pad bulk the 6 ohm maximum applies from the bulk instead

pair_xref.feed_path: The pair's own M6 supply terminals on the XREF strip, VSS at (45.215, 13.365) and VDD at (46.915, 14.565) um in core coordinates, south into the decoupling below the XREF and east along it. Nothing enters the CDAC array keep-out.

digital_sar.note: Includes DCAP fillers inside the macro

analog_bootstrap.note: Bootstrap event is an upper bound; confirm with branch currents

migration_acceptance.geometry: same normalized GDS geometry and cell connectivity
migration_acceptance.drc: no new markers; preserve two original warnings
migration_acceptance.tt: same ten-frame fixture, compare code, event counts, sampling closes and conversion times
migration_acceptance.timing_tolerance_basis: one maximum saved/transient step of the unchanged short fixture; report actual differences

fill: Follow Layout/specs/fill-policy.md: retain required matching/device dummies in the core; manage density fill separately. Gain-sensitive modules (CDAC) own a deterministic in-footprint OD/PO plan aligned to the unit grid plus PDK fill-blocking layers over their sensitive conductors, and are qualified with that plan in place; the top level fills everywhere else and honors the blocks. Final qualification uses actual filled top DRC/LVS/PEX.
qualification: DRC execution, LVS, functionality, settling, parasitics and terminal reliability are separate verdicts.
